article.title: Toy nationalism the polity that is Russia
article.excerpt: There hadn’t been many – indeed any – rallies like it before in Russia . Last month saw dozens of toys, from teddy bears to Lego figurines , standing out in the snow of a Siberian city with banners complaining about corruption and electoral malpractice.
